title: Volley Mailbox Channel Message
description: Inbound request or command directed at this agent. Must-deliver: see spec section 4.4 for message ids, acks and the persistent-session requirement. The mailbox 'nudge' type is a lightweight prod to re-evaluate, distinct from the deferred control-channel 'nudge' lifecycle command.

seq.description: Monotonic per sender; lets a recipient order and de-duplicate messages.

supersedes.description: Message id (correlation_id) of an earlier message this one replaces.

acked_type.description: On an ack: the type of the message being acknowledged.
